snippet.title: Tomb Raider Remastered I-III - Free Challenge Mode Patch | Out Now on All Platforms
snippet.description:
The new Challenge Mode is a free patch that adds bonus content to all platforms including new outfits with upgraded abilities, a level modifier to challenge your skills, and all new achievements to earn. Get the complete experience now (including all expansions and secret levels for all three games) on iOS, Android, Nintendo Switch 2 in addition to all previous consoles and PC.

New Update Features:
• 10 New Outfits: Complete achievements to unlock 10 New Outfits that enhance Lara’s abilities and push you further on your next run.
• Challenge Mode: Test your skills by customizing levels. Modify health, damage, bonuses, enemies, and more. The higher the challenge rating, the more you’ll unlock.
• 15 New Achievements: Increase your trophy collection with the addition of new Challenge Mode achievements.

Nintendo Switch 1 owners will get a free upgrade to Nintendo Switch 2 starting March 18

PlayStation: https://bit.ly/3OWSYyn
Nintendo Switch: https://bit.ly/4deTd1B
Nintendo Switch 2: https://bit.ly/40rU5Zo
Xbox: https://bit.ly/3N2bHYK
Steam: https://bit.ly/3KQvol0
iOS: https://apple.co/4s8HWVn
Google Play: https://bit.ly/3NBtVAp

Coming soon: GOG & Epic
